name: Casa Alcores
description:
Set within the exclusive Alcores del Golf community in Nueva Andalucía, this beautifully renovated 3-bedroom home offers a calm and elegant setting right on the golf course. The interiors have been designed in a refined, contemporary style with soft neutral tones, clean lines and a bright open-plan layout that flows effortlessly from the living area into the modern kitchen and out onto the terrace. Large glass doors bring in plenty of natural light and frame the lush green surroundings, creating a peaceful atmosphere throughout the home.

Outside, the spacious curved terrace is a real highlight, with relaxing lounge areas, outdoor dining and a built-in BBQ/summer kitchen setup for easy entertaining. The property enjoys lovely front-line golf views and access to beautifully maintained communal gardens and swimming pools, all within a secure and sought-after residential setting. With its stylish finishes, serene outlook and prime Nueva Andalucía location close to golf, beaches, restaurants and Puerto Banús, this is a superb home for a comfortable Marbella stay.

Please note that we welcome families and couples only, no groups under 30, and no hen or stag parties. Should you fall outside of this category but wish to book nonetheless, please send us an enquiry detailing a bit more about yourself and the group that you will be travelling with so we can request this for you.

We look forward to welcoming you!
